newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Ciba share floor price set at 74 Sfr.
newsitem.headline: Ciba share floor price set at 74 Sfr.

text.p: The floor price for Ciba Specialty Chemicals Holding Inc shares has been set by a bank consortium at 74 Swiss francs per share, a source close to the transaction said.
That represents a minimum price of 64 Swiss francs at which the consortium will buy rights to the shares that start trading tomorrow, he said.

"This reflects the confidence the banking syndicate had for the issue," the source said, noting the floor price was within the indicated price range of 72 to 86 francs announced last week for the global offer of Ciba Specialty shares to the public.

Strong retail demand pushed grey market quotes for Ciba shares to around 109 to 111 francs today, dealers said, but they noted the thin market was keeping prices rather high above the indicated public offer price.

The indicative price range values the company, being spun off from Novartis, at up to 6.21 billion francs. The final issue price and allotment will be announced on March 13 after a complicated system of book-building is completed.

Rights for the shares start trading tomorrow and should be around 10 francs below the expected share price, given the 10 franc exercise price for Novartis shareholders getting them in a one-for-one rights issue.
The consortium will use the rights to get Ciba shares that will be offered to the public in a global issue of at least 300 million francs worth of shares. Share trading starts March 13.
